html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 19, 2022

On Aug 16, 2022, global ecom SaaS Dianxiaomi (店小秘) (founded 2014) closed a $110M Series D led by Sequoia China and SoftBank Vision Fund II, with Tiger Global, GGV, and Huaxing New Economy following — for overseas team and intl expansion. Free cross-platform ERP + Saihu (Amazon fine ops), BigSeller (SEA local; 430k+ sellers; monetization day-one ¥1M+), UpSeller (LatAm; users ~2× YTD), Duoke CS, 17TRACK logistics, Xiaomi Cloud Warehouse. Connects 32 top platforms (Amazon, eBay, Wish, AliExpress, Shopee, Shopify…) + hundreds of logistics/overseas warehouses. 6 rounds total; UBO Du Jianyin 27.3%.

— END —
